description: This is a Kotlin source file that defines the TalkModeManager class, which manages voice recognition, text-to-speech, and chat session interactions within an Android app. It handles speech recognition lifecycle, TTS playback, chat subscription, session management, and related functionalities for voice-based interactions.

classes.name: TalkModeManager
classes.description: Manages voice recognition, text-to-speech playback, and chat session interactions in an Android app, facilitating voice-based communication and control.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the voice interaction mode, starting or stopping recognition accordingly.

methods.name: speakWakeCommand
methods.description: Processes a wake-word command by sending it as chat, waiting for responses, and playing back the assistant's reply.

methods.name: playTtsForText
methods.description: Plays a given text string using TTS, handling playback state and session management.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming gateway events, such as chat responses, and triggers appropriate actions like TTS playback.

methods.name: setPlaybackEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables playback of assistant responses, stopping TTS if disabled.

methods.name: refreshConfig
methods.description: Reloads configuration settings from the gateway session.

methods.name: speakAssistantReply
methods.description: Speaks a provided assistant reply text, managing playback session.

methods.name: stopTts
methods.description: Stops ongoing TTS playback and resets the speaking state.
